tools.name: powerhub_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with their status, buyer, totals and marketplace source. Filter by order date, external id, SKU, EAN, buyer e-mail or archive flag. Vendor API: GET /sm-orders/orders.

tools.name: powerhub_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its receiver address, delivery method, status and remarks. Vendor API: GET /sm-orders/orders/{id}.

tools.name: powerhub_list_products
tools.description: List catalogue products with price, VAT, EAN, SKU and stock per warehouse. Filter by name, EAN, SKU, product code, manufacturer, price or quantity range. Vendor API: GET /sm-stock/products.

tools.name: powerhub_get_product
tools.description: Get one product with its base price, price lists, dimensions, weight, EAN and SKU. Vendor API: GET /sm-stock/products/{id}.

tools.name: powerhub_get_product_inventory
tools.description: Get the stock rows of one product: stock in hand, reserved, ordered and the storage place per warehouse. Vendor API: GET /sm-stock/products/{id}/inventory.

tools.name: powerhub_list_stocks
tools.description: List the warehouses (stocks) of the account with their name and address. Vendor API: GET /sm-stock/stocks.

tools.name: powerhub_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments with carrier, waybill number, receiver and status history. Filter by waybill, external id, reference, creation date or cash on delivery. Vendor API: GET /sm-shipments/shipments.

tools.name: powerhub_get_shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment with its carrier, receiver, packages and status history. Vendor API: GET /sm-shipments/shipments/{id}.

tools.name: powerhub_list_carriers
tools.description: List the shipping carriers connected to the account. Vendor API: GET /sm-shipments/carriers.

tools.name: powerhub_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales documents (invoices and receipts) with buyer, amount, currency, payment type and paid amount. Vendor API: GET /sm-orders/billing/invoices.
